description_en: Queries and ranks historical usage duration by end user or desktop
description_zh: 按用户或桌面维度查询并排序历史使用时长
name: QueryHistoryUsageDurationRank

parameters.help_en: The start date of the query in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. You can query data within the last 90 days
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始日期。格式：YYYY-MM-DD。最多支持查询 90 天数据
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end date of the query in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. You can query data within the last 90 days
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束日期。格式：YYYY-MM-DD。最多支持查询 90 天数据
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return. The default value is 5, and the maximum value is 200
parameters.help_zh: 查询结果数量。默认值为 5，最大为 200
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. You can obtain this token from the response to the previous request
parameters.help_zh: 下次分页查询的 Token，从上一次返回结果中获取
parameters.name: next_token
